description: This file defines custom matchers and the expect API for Playwright testing framework, including proxy-based matcher creation, polling support, and integration with test steps.

classes.name: ExpectMetaInfoProxyHandler
classes.description: Proxy handler for managing matcher property access, resolving qualified matcher names, and handling poll support.

methods.name: createMatchers
methods.description: Creates a proxy object for matchers with attached meta information.

methods.name: createExpect
methods.description: Constructs a proxy-based expect object with configuration, extension, and polling support.

methods.name: setMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Sets the current matcher call context for tracking expect info and test step.

methods.name: takeMatcherCallContext
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the current matcher call context.

methods.name: wrapPlaywrightMatcherToPassNiceThis
methods.description: Wraps a matcher to pass Playwright-specific context such as timeout and soft assertions.

methods.name: throwUnsupportedExpectMatcherError
methods.description: Throws an error for unsupported custom matchers.

methods.name: pollMatcher
methods.description: Performs polling for a matcher until timeout or success, used for expect.poll() support.
